The #y~Pan #yKu #yBox~ floats beside you, and you faintly hear the hair-raising #r@demonic @whispers@ from afar. Several specific places on the map seem to be calling to you...

Ignoring the gods' warning, you forcibly pry open a corner of the box. A piercing #p~chill~ drills into your mind through your fingertips, but at the same time, the box recognizes your #rambition. The #r@Demon @Gates@ have opened for you, but the haze in your heart lingers for a long time.
